# Understood

> Understood is a nonprofit resource platform providing comprehensive information and support for the 70 million people with learning and thinking differences including ADHD, dyslexia, and dyscalculia.

Understood offers evidence-based guides, strategies, and tools for individuals, parents, educators, and workplace professionals navigating learning and thinking differences. The platform covers diagnosis, accommodations, assistive technology, and emotional support across school and work settings.

## Key Topics

- ADHD
- Dyslexia
- Dyscalculia
- Learning disabilities
- IEP (Individualized Education Program)
- 504 plans
- Special education
- Assistive technology
- Classroom accommodations
- Parenting strategies
- Workplace accommodations
- Language disorders
- Executive function
- Mental health support
- Free resources

## Core Conditions & Diagnosis

- [ADHD](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/adhd): Comprehensive guide to ADHD symptoms, diagnosis, strategies, and medication management
- [Dyslexia](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/dyslexia): Resource hub covering dyslexia diagnosis, classroom accommodations, and coping strategies
- [Dyscalculia](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/dyscalculia): Guide to dyscalculia math difficulties, classroom accommodations, and assistive technology
- [Language disorders](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/language-disorder): Expert information on expressive and receptive language disorders and speech-language pathology
- [Written expression disorder](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/written-expression-disorder): Guide to written expression disorder, dysgraphia, and writing support strategies
- [Signs and symptoms of ADHD and learning disabilities](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/signs-and-symptoms): Overview of ADHD and learning disability signs, diagnosis evaluation, and child development

## School Supports & Legal Rights

- [IEPs](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/ieps): Comprehensive guide to Individualized Education Programs, meetings, and disability rights
- [504 plans](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/504-plans): Guide to Section 504 plans, student accommodations, and disability rights under law
- [School supports and special education](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/school-supports): Guide to IEPs, 504 plans, special education, and school accommodations for students
- [Resources for teachers about learning disabilities and ADHD](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/educators): Teaching strategies, IEP accommodations, and classroom support for students with disabilities

## Parenting & Family Support

- [Parenting](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/parenting): Parenting strategies for ADHD, behavior management, and learning disability support
- [ADHD and women](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/adhd-women): ADHD diagnosis, symptom management, and support resources specific to women
- [Managing Emotions](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/managing-emotions): Strategies for managing emotions, anger, and anxiety related to ADHD and learning disabilities
- [Trouble with organization](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/staying-organized): Organization and time management strategies for ADHD and executive function challenges

## Tools & Accommodations

- [Assistive technology in school and at work](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/assistive-technology): Guide to text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and adaptive tools for learning disabilities
- [Workplace supports and accommodations](https://www.understood.org/en/topics/workplace-supports): Tips for workplace accommodations under ADA and thriving with learning differences at work

## Community & Resources

- [All Topics](https://www.understood.org/en/topics): Topic directory covering ADHD, dyslexia, learning disabilities, and special education
- [Newsletters](https://www.understood.org/en/newsletters): Newsletter signup for families, educators, and women with learning and thinking differences

## Homepage

- [Understood - For learning and thinking differences](https://www.understood.org): Homepage for Understood nonprofit supporting 70M people with learning and thinking differences
